verdict.rationale: Anrok publishes its own API reference at apidocs.anrok.com, backed by an OpenAPI spec (openapi.yaml), with endpoint descriptions and tutorials that include a copy-pasteable curl request. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive 'try it' console or in-browser runnable examples. The probe found openapi.json, swagger.json and llms.txt returning 404, although the YAML spec is cited. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser explorer, runnable/executable examples beyond static curl snippets, sandbox or test-mode execution from the docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Now that you have a Product ID in Anrok and have generated an API key, you're ready to make your first API request.
Use Anrok's Transactions API to synchronize transactions between Anrok and your billing system, as well as calculate sales tax for new invoices.
